text:
Tess: quick pass on compact stack traces — on dense traces the tiny chevron to expand frames is getting missed and it overlaps the gutter sometimes.
Priya: saw same during a support call. users click the span title expecting expand. low contrast + 8px hit area = confusion.
Alex: two options: 1) enlarge clickable area and move control left of the title, or 2) replace chevron with an inline pill button that reads a verb + count (e.g., "Show 12 frames"). pill seems more discoverable.
Miguel: pill + specs: #f3f5f8 bg, 10px horizontal padding, 12px type, 6px border-radius. Also, should it be "Show N frames" or "N hidden frames" for clarity?
Tess: prefer action-first "Show N frames". keyboard: must be tabbable and work with Enter/Space. current chevron is not keyboard-focusable.
Maya (a11y): add aria-expanded, aria-controls linking to the frame list id, and SR text like "Show 12 frames for span 0xabc". When collapsed SR should say "collapsed, 12 frames hidden".
Alex: backend note: lazy-load frames via `GET /api/traces/:id/frames?span=:span_id` to avoid large payloads. emit analytics `trace.stack.expand` with span_id, frames_count, source=ui.
Jordan: microcopy nit: the correlation ID copy tooltip currently says just "copy". change to "Copy correlation ID". also expose "Copy trace permalink" in trace header overflow — export actions belong at trace level by default.
Priya: agree header-level export for full trace (JSON/har). keep a per-span "Export frames" (plain text) action for quick debugging. split responsibilities.
Tess: toasts: avoid terse "Copied". use "Copied correlation ID to clipboard" or "Copied 2 correlation IDs to clipboard". pluralize properly.
Miguel: perf UX: expanding many frames can cause reflow. do a CSS max-height transition (200ms ease) plus progressive render / virtualization for lists > 30.
Alex: implement transition + virtualized inner list. propose keyboard shortcut `e` to toggle span expand when focused; ensure it doesn't collide with global shortcuts.
Maya (a11y): shortcut ok but add an accessibility pref to disable shortcuts for SR users. ensure focus lands on first frame after expand and SR announces "expanded" with frame count.
Jordan: plan: Priya+Alex prototype in staging by EOW. Tess+Miguel will finalize pill visuals and toast copy. Maya will run quick a11y pass on staging. I'll open a PR and tag reviewers. @a11y-bot queue an axe scan after the staging build.
a11y-bot: axe scan queued for build 2025.11.2 — results will post in #eng-oncall when complete.
